description: Returns a complete single-file HTML game wired to this room: realtime movement plus an anonymous (claimable) player, a saved color (datastore), and a click leaderboard. Write it to disk and open it. The game it is wired to is stamped in a comment at the top of the file.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.
